top_signals.title: Traders Load Up on Hedges for Shallower Fed Rate-Hike Cycle
top_signals.summary: Traders are shielding themselves from the possibility that the Federal Reserve raises interest rates less than markets are currently pricing in.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Lone Star Said to Mull Options for Coffee-Machine Firm Evoca
top_signals.summary: Private equity firm Lone Star Funds is mulling its options for Evoca SpA, including a potential handover of the business to creditors or a sale of the debt-laden Italian coffee machine maker, people familiar with the matter said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
